cheats.name: Have 99 Carrots
cheats.note: With all Carrots collected. You will be allowed into mini-games and secret areas

cheats.name: Level Select
cheats.note: When you press Pause in-game and Stage Quit yo will go to the Stage Screen this cheat lets you choose what Stage you would like to go to but make sure you turn the cheat off and press A to continue to that stage.
